description:
Yoon Jae Oh: He is a self-proclaimed timid junior but in front of someone he’s interested in, I don’t know smirk His hobby is playing console games. His special ability is to concentrate as much as he can.

Woo Si-hyun: The senior whose character lies between tenderness and iron walls. His type are cuties without tricks. His hobby is bike riding. His special ability is threading through a needle at once.

Si-hyun is an ordinary college student possessing hidden superpowers. On the way to an exam, he was asked for help by his juniors so he was cleaning the club room by himself. When he was trying to organize quickly using his superpowers, Jae-oh, a junior suddenly appeared!
